title: Get started with essential8
text: essential8 computes component composite Life’s Essential 8 (LE8) cardiovascular health scores. current implementation scores adults aged 20 years older using American Heart Association’s 2022 definition. Pediatric scoring yet available. vignette shows score complete incomplete data. examples use dplyr native pipe (|>, available R 4.1+). See ?score_le8 input requirements scoring details.
